riskRemaining: Delivery is at-least-once by design: a job whose lease expires during a long provider call can be re-claimed and re-executed; the scheduler/wait adapter and backpressure (429/503) from the parent spec are intentionally out of this tracer bullet, as are retry backoff scheduling and dead-letter retention.
